title: StreamBeam ENS
tagline: Reward active STREAMBEAM users with free third-level ENS domains
description:
This project builds on top of STREAMBEAM - on-chain donation platform for live-streamers that I built on ETH Global Prague. 
For users who donated more than $10 overall, we gift them a free ENS domain with their Twitch name. And as a prototype, those domains can be used in a leaderboard.
how_its_made: I'm using existing STREAMBEAM subgraph with donation information. First we check if user is eligible for reward. After using Twitch OAuth and EIP-712 signature we connect Twitch account with an address and generate an off-chain subdomain. Custom Offchain Resolver is deployed on Ethereum Mainnet.
